matchups.recap: Rob got absolutely skull-fucked by an 8-point deficit this week, which is impressive considering he somehow managed to field a roster that scored 111 and still thought he had a shot. That's the fantasy equivalent of showing up to a gunfight with a butter knife and wondering why you lost—Rob didn't just leave points on the bench, he fucking gift-wrapped them and handed them to Rinor like it was Christmas morning. Better luck next week, chief, but based on your roster construction, I wouldn't hold my breath.

Adam got absolutely throttled this week, limping across the finish line with 74.8 points like a three-legged dog in a race it never should've entered—losing by 11.2 to Flamur's respectable 86.1 is the kind of beat-down that makes you question every waiver-wire pickup you've made all season. Your roster performed like it was actively trying to sabotage you, and honestly, it probably was just tired of being managed this poorly. Next week's gonna hurt even more when you realize you could've won this if literally any of your "sleepers" had actually woken the fuck up.

Rilind got absolutely skullfucked this week—down 62 points is the kind of ass-whooping that makes you question every life decision that led to drafting this particular collection of ghosts. Your lineup looked like a fucking obituary column, and Arben's team showed up ready to play while yours apparently got the message that the league started next week. At this rate, your only path to the playoffs is if everyone else's rosters spontaneously combust.

Jetmir and Peter got absolutely skull-fucked this week, losing by nearly 58 points—that's not a matchup, that's a public execution. You two combined had the offensive output of a practice squad team playing in a snowstorm, and Nori's lineup just kept piling on the corpse like he was trying to break the scoring record. This wasn't even close enough to be embarrassing; it was straight-up humiliating. Next time maybe actually set your lineups before kickoff instead of whatever fever dream you submitted.

Ben got absolutely skullfucked by 8.8 points this week—and not in the fun way. Somehow managed to scrape together 89.6 points like he was working with a roster full of practice squad guys and a prayer. Ilir's 98.4 wasn't even a landslide, but that's what happens when you roll out what looks like a lineup assembled by someone who drafted exclusively on bye weeks and vibes. Better luck next week, champ—you're gonna need it.

Veton got absolutely dick-slapped by 16.7 points this week, which is fitting since his roster management has been getting fucked for the last month. You managed to put together a team that scores 100 and somehow still felt like that was respectable—newsflash, it's not. Faton showed up with actual competence and left you wondering where your season went, and spoiler alert: it's in the same dumpster where your draft picks landed.

matchups.preview: Rob's 0-3 record isn't a fluke—it's a masterclass in fantasy incompetence, and Flamur's about to add another victim to his undefeated resume. When you're winless three weeks in, you don't suddenly figure it out against the hottest team in the league, especially when Rob's still probably convincing himself that his draft-day reaches on injury-prone has-beens will "pay off any week now." Flamur's rolling, Rob's rolling over, and this is going to be a bloodbath.

Arben's 3-0 start is cute, but let's be real—he's been riding the waiver wire like it owes him money and his playoff schedule is about to bend him over sideways. Rinor's sitting at 2-1 with actual roster construction, and he's about to remind everyone that early-season luck runs out faster than Arben's remaining easy matchups. Time for the undefeated streak to meet reality.

Nori's sitting pretty at 2-1 while Adam's already drowning at 1-2, but don't let that fool you—Nori's got the consistency of a kicker with the yips and Adam's due for one of those "fuck it, let's win out" streaks that never actually happen. This is the perfect storm for Nori to absolutely blow it against someone desperate enough to actually set a good lineup this week.

Ben's sitting at 1-2 with what looks like a roster that got assembled at a gas station, while Rilind's somehow equally pathetic despite having actual draft capital to work with—this week one of you finally gets to feel marginally less like a dumpster fire, but spoiler alert: you're both about to disappoint your entire league simultaneously.

Veton's out here 0-3 looking like he drafted with his eyes closed and his brain in another timezone—meanwhile Jetmir and Peter are limping in at 1-2 like they've actually seen a football game or two. This is the classic matchup of "complete dumpster fire" versus "slightly less flaming dumpster fire," and honestly Veton's just trying to avoid making it 0-4 while these two smell blood and remember what a win feels like.

Muriqi's sitting pretty at 2-1, but let's be honest—that record's held together with duct tape and prayer, not skill. Asllani's coming in with the same record but actually earned it, and this week he's about to remind Muriqi that 2-1 doesn't mean shit when your roster decides to collectively shit the bed on Sunday. One of you clowns is about to learn a hard lesson about regression to the mean, and spoiler alert: it's the guy who's been riding waiver wire pickups and injury luck all season.
